skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply correct pronunciation of vowels.
Understand and apply correct pronunciation of consonants.
Identify and apply correct word stress in pronunciation.
Identify and apply correct sentence stress in pronunciation.
Recognize and apply appropriate intonation patterns in various types of sentences.
Understand and apply linking sounds between words.
Apply weak and strong forms in everyday communication.
Identify and analyze personal pronunciation errors and make corrections.
Improve overall communication skills through better pronunciation.
Develop independent learning habits and self-improvement.
Work effectively in pairs and groups during class activities.
